details.description: Stable Image Core is Stability AI's fast, affordable text-to-image generation model, offered on Amazon Bedrock as stability.stable-image-core-v1:1. It takes only a text prompt (no input image) and returns a single generated image in JPEG or PNG, with a selectable aspect ratio and output dimensions between 640 and 1,536 pixels per side. AWS describes it as delivering 'exceptional speed and efficiency while maintaining the high-quality output synonymous with Stable Diffusion models.'
advantages: AWS describes Stable Image Core as delivering exceptional speed and efficiency while maintaining Stable Diffusion's characteristic image quality.
Supports nine selectable aspect ratios for text-to-image generation (16:9, 1:1, 21:9, 2:3, 3:2, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 9:21), per AWS Bedrock documentation.
disadvantages: Text-to-image only; AWS Bedrock's documented request parameters for this model do not include an input-image field, so it cannot edit an existing image.
use_cases: General-purpose creative image generation from a text prompt
